# Workshop resources {.unnumbered}

Welcome to the workshop! Below you will find the materials for all ten taught sessions, organised in the order they will be presented. The workshop will cover a selection of material from this book, with the remaining chapters provided for self-study and future reference.

For each session, you will use three resources:

*   **Book:** Each chapter includes a more detailed exploration of the subject with code. You can read this if you are stuck or something is not clear.
*   **Alternative slides:** For three sessions, a second deck that teaches the theory with animations, given before the session slides.
*   **Slides:** The presentation slides shown in the room at the start of each session.
*   **Worksheet:** The file you will fill in during the workshop. It is in your course folder under `worksheets/`, and that is the copy to open in VS Code. Clicking the link downloads the same Quarto (`.qmd`) file.

**Optional: Interactive Pluto Notebooks**

Each session also includes an optional Pluto notebook, which provides the chapter model but adds sliders for exploring parameters. These are not required to complete the workshop.

The **Pluto preview** is a saved copy of the notebook: it shows the model at its default values, and its sliders do not move. To change a parameter and see the figures update, open the **Pluto source** in Pluto. Pluto is installed along with the other course packages, so it is ready to use; the [Setting up](setup.qmd) guide shows how to start it.
